commands.command: Launch the native Workbench executable on Windows 10 Pro x64 with PATH=C:\Windows\System32 and isolated APPDATA, LOCALAPPDATA, TEMP, TMP and WebView2 data; inspect its GUI window and process tree
commands.summary: RepoPact Workbench window title and nonzero window handle observed; only child was msedgewebview2.exe, with no Python or pip child. The native app launched without Python/pip available on PATH.

commands.command: Install Android API 35 x86_64 debug APK; use SAF to acquire a clean Core checkout; open it in the Workbench UI; validate and run a typed graph search
commands.summary: Android app opened the SAF-granted repository. Core returned valid=true, zero errors/warnings; graph query returned 50 nodes with working_overlay basis. The APK contains no Python interpreter, pip executable or libpython, and no Python/pip process was observed.

commands.command: Reuse Windows 11 x64 native launch evidence from Workbench commit 9894b03eb77bc70bdee2aebcbc712de307c254a6
commands.summary: Prior isolated launch also excluded Python/pip from PATH and observed no Python child. Windows 10 and Windows 11 are intentional separate platform matrix entries.

environment.limitation: Desktop repository-picker interaction was not exercised; the prior capture helper failed with SetIsBorderRequired (0x80004002) and was not retried. Keep RPS-009 pending until the desktop interaction boundary is operator-verified.
